AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evaluation_organization_mappings permission_mapping JOIN organization_user_mappings target_mapping ON target_mapping.organization_code = permission_mapping.organization_code WHERE permission_mapping.user_id = #{requesterUserId} AND permission_mapping.business_type = 'FACULTY_ACHIEVEMENT' AND permission_mapping.data_scope IN ('DEPARTMENT', 'COLLEGE', 'BUSINESS', 'ALL') AND target_mapping.user_id = achievement.target_user_id AND target_mapping.status = 'ACTIVE' )

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teaching_improvement_achievements ( management_no, target_user_id, management_item_code, achievement_date, achievement_content, academic_year, semester, certification_status, attachment_ids, deleted_yn, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{managementNo}, #{targetUserId}, #{managementItemCode}, #{achievementDate}, #{achievementContent}, #{academicYear}, #{semester}, 'DRAFT', CAST(#{attachmentIds} AS jsonb), 'N', #{createdBy}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE teaching_improvement_achievements SET management_item_code = #{managementItemCode}, achievement_date = #{achievementDate}, achievement_content = #{achievementContent}, academic_year = #{academicYear}, semester = #{semester}, attachment_ids = CAST(#{attachmentIds} AS jsonb), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND deleted_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO data_change_histories ( target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason, request_id ) VALUES ( #{targetBusiness}, #{targetKey}, #{changeType}, #{fieldName}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason}, #{requestId} )
